sections.title: Page 1
sections.hint: When you stop, the last letter drops its haraka and takes a sukoon:  رَ ← رۡ   We still write the word as it is in the Mushaf. Workbook Level 3, page 1 — Stopping (Waqf). Tap a form to hear it, then trace it on the page.

sections.title: Page 2
sections.hint: Stop on ـٌ or ـٍ: the tanween drops and the letter takes a sukoon:  دٌ ← دۡ Stop on ـً: say an alif instead, 2 counts (madd iwad):  مًا ← مَا Workbook Level 3, page 2 — Stopping (Waqf). Tap a form to hear it, then trace it on the page.

sections.title: Page 3
sections.hint: Taa marbuta ة: keep reading → say ت  ·  stop → say هۡ Even with ةً you stop with هۡ — no alif. Right box: keep going. Left box: stop. Workbook Level 3, page 3 — Stopping (Waqf). Tap a form to hear it, then trace it on the page.

sections.title: Page 4
sections.hint: Stop right after a madd letter: stretch it 2, 4 or 6 counts (madd aarid). Pick one and keep it the same. A qalqala letter at the stop still bounces:  بۡ  دۡ Workbook Level 3, page 4 — Stopping (Waqf). Tap a form to hear it, then trace it on the page.
